coverageNote: CMMC Level 1, the 15 basic safeguarding requirements at 48 CFR 52.204-21(b)(1)(i) through (xv), which 32 CFR 170.14(b) adopts as the Level 1 security requirements. What is solid here, stated plainly: (1) Every topicSummary is the VERBATIM regulatory text, read out of the eCFR API for 48 CFR 52.204-21 -- not a paraphrase. Federal regulations are US Government works and carry no copyright, which is why this module can ship the real text where the HITRUST, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 modules deliberately cannot. (2) The identifiers are the regulation's own roman-numeral paragraph designations; there is no other numbering for these. All 15 were extracted from a single eCFR fetch and the count matches 32 CFR 170.14(b)(1). (3) Every topicLabel is DERIVED -- a short phrase cut from the requirement's own opening clause so the dashboard and interview have something readable. It is not regulatory text and carries no authority; read the topicSummary for that. (4) Level 1 covers Federal Contract Information (FCI), not CUI, and is validated by annual self-assessment with an affirmation in SPRS -- there is no certificate and no C3PAO for Level 1. Confirm your contract's actual CMMC level and the applicable DFARS clause with your contracting officer before relying on any of this.
